h: 该工作流程来自快手Kolors团队官方工作流程。它将文本生成的图像和图像生成的图像组合到一个工作流程中。它经过idesign调整和优化，具有快速启动和停止按钮，方便使用。

o.en: This workflow comes from the official workflow of the Kuaishou Kolors team. It combines text-generated images and image-generated images into one workflow. It is adjusted and optimized by idesign and has quick start and stop buttons for easy use.
